images.caption:
Taman Nasional Baluran, Banyuwangi Jawa timur, dikatakan Africa Van Java atau Afrika nya Jawa. Kondisi alam berupa hamparan safana menjadi rumah bagi puluhan spesies fauna dan flora, hal ini menjadi daya tarik wisata taman nasional ini.
Tak perlu jauh-jauh ke Afrika cukup ke Baluran kita dapat menikmati secuil Afrika minus singa.
images.alt:

images.caption: This national park consists of savanna vegetation types, mangrove forests, seasonal forests, coastal forests, lower mountain forests, swamp forests and forests that are always green throughout the year. Savanna vegetation types dominate the Baluran National Park area, which is about 40 percent of the total land area.
